findings.evidence: `Mathlib/GroupTheory/Coxeter/Basic.lean:370-382` defines `CoxeterSystem.wordProd` with exactly the same list-of-simple-generators product and structural lemma names; the new parallel API appears at `SimpleReflections.lean:54-70`.
findings.fix: Rename it to `wordProd` (in an appropriate base/root-pairing namespace if disambiguation is needed) and consistently rename `simpleWordProd_nil`, `simpleWordProd_cons`, `simpleWordProd_append`, `exists_simpleWordProd_eq`, and the deletion theorem.
findings.issue: `simpleWordProd` is nonstandard terminology for the product represented by a word; Mathlib calls this operation `CoxeterSystem.wordProd`, with matching `wordProd_nil`, `wordProd_cons`, and `wordProd_append` lemmas.

summary: The new word-product API uses terminology inconsistent with the existing Mathlib Coxeter API.
